description:
Tells Google to check for the verification token and, if it finds it, records this credential as an owner. Run get_verification_token first and place the token — this call only checks, it does not place anything.

A failure here is almost always "not there yet" rather than "wrong": DNS records take minutes to an hour to propagate, and a freshly uploaded file may still be behind a CDN cache. Retrying later is the normal response.

method.description: Must match the method the token was obtained for. Defaults to DNS for a domain property and META for a URL-prefix property.

site_url.description: The Search Console property: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or "https://example.com/" for a URL-prefix property (the trailing slash is required)

name: verify_site

owners.description: Other people’s addresses, as Google has them.

anyOf.description: Google's id for the verified resource.

title: Verify ownership
